evidence.quote: THX-01 is a non-autoregressive, multilingual decision model developed by HAL-X AI.

Post-training covers Azerbaijani, English, Russian, Turkish, German, French, Spanish, Arabic, Hindi, Chinese, Persian, Georgian, Japanese, Korean, Ukrainian, Kazakh, Uzbek and Italian, with Azerbaijani the largest in every synthetic component.
Fine-grained intent sets with many near-synonymous labels remain hard: Banking77 (77 intents) reaches 65.9%.
